WHAT: FluidAudio → Whisper fallback in DynamicTranscriber

WHERE: src-tauri/src/transcription/dynamic_transcriber.rs

HOW: AudioData is cloned before FluidAudio attempt. If FluidAudio returns Err, retry the clone with Whisper. warn! log emitted on fallback.

WHY: Previously FluidAudio errors propagated silently — no transcription output, no retry. User saw spinner forever.

GOTCHA: Clone happens on EVERY call even when FluidAudio succeeds (~4MB for 60s audio). Accepted cost for simplicity. Don't optimize unless profiling shows it matters.
